derivation_rules.explicit_behavior_or_role_wording: May project to a controlled value only when the source wording directly supports that value; retain source locator and raw qualifier where useful.
derivation_rules.mechanic_alone: An attack, resistance, movement mode, damage type, CR/threat value, size, game type or Ability does not by itself establish ecological role.
derivation_rules.habitat_or_distribution_alone: Habitat suitability and canonical range do not establish trophic, social, ecosystem or encounter-use role.
derivation_rules.predator: Requires source wording or behavior that directly establishes predation; does not identify a prey species unless separately sourced.
derivation_rules.resource_feeder: Use for explicitly sourced consumption of nonordinary physical, spatial, energetic or comparable resources; preserve the raw target instead of forcing Earth trophic vocabulary.
derivation_rules.guardian: Records a source-backed guarding/protective role only; does not imply owner, faction, personhood, domestication, loyalty or consent state.
derivation_rules.community_use: A statement that communities use a creature does not by itself establish domestication, ownership, training or partnership.
derivation_rules.source_category_profile: May provide scoped encounter-use facets only to records explicitly established as members of that source category; category membership never creates identity or distribution.

encounter_projection_rules.rule: CEW-06 encounter-use facets support authorized discovery, filtering and preparation. PPIA-02 Campaign/Scene placement remains the authority for participant role, quantity, wave, starting assumptions and live runtime state.

cew07_handoff.name: Existing Creature Coverage Audit
cew07_handoff.rule: CEW-07 measures which recovered/canonical creature records have source-backed facts across the CEW-01..06 identity, type, classification, habitat, distribution and ecological-role contracts without inventing missing facts.
